description.value:
“A Producer's Share: a cut of the house, for one lucky contestant.” (Open 1, rival max 1)

A trap. Whoever signs must make a DC 25 Will save or be bound as @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.Item.ofw6gnp6r7t2wcba]{lesser geas} not to leave the Garden before the finale. Sense Motive DC 25 reveals the catch.
